title: `BIGINT >> BIGINT`
description: 0 for shifts below 0 or beyond 63 (`-5 >> 64` too).
reference: `shift_right` raises on shifts below 0 or beyond 63.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe` runs the function at each signature on edge cases (0, ±1, ±2, 3, ±7, the 64-bit bounds, 0.5, ±2.5, 1e308, ±inf, NaN, NULL), one row at a time from columns, under every combination of `error_on_division_by_zero` and `ieee_floating_point_ops`. Lean evaluates the Substrait call on the same rows once per candidate value of its option (`substrait-check --outcomes`), and the candidates whose outcomes all match are DuckDB's options. No input is -0.0 (duckdb-R14).

evidence.note: BitwiseShiftRightOperator: input >> shift for shift in [0, width), else 0

provenance.notes: One template for every width, with the range relative to the width: at i8, `x >> 8` is 0 (also for a negative `x`), and inside the range the shift is arithmetic (a narrow operand is promoted to `int` first). sverify's reference states the range for 64 bits.
